capabilities.label: View-dependent holographic foil material
capabilities.useWhen: A Three.js surface needs diffraction bands, thin-film iridescence, metallic flakes, refractor facets, and environment reflections.

capabilities.label: Distance-field die-cut mask
capabilities.useWhen: Transparent artwork needs a cut border with tolerance that closes small counters and gaps.

capabilities.label: Pointer-driven foil tilt
capabilities.useWhen: Pointer movement should rotate the sticker and sweep view-dependent foil bands.

capabilities.label: Three-dimensional peel and exploded layers
capabilities.useWhen: A sticker needs a graded hinge bend, conical curl, foil backside, or separated backing, foil, and artwork layers.

capabilities.label: Transparent PNG and GLB export
capabilities.useWhen: The rendered sticker must be exported as a transparent bitmap or current 3D geometry.

capabilities.label: Sweep and peel animation export
capabilities.useWhen: The requested deliverable explicitly includes looping GIF or WebM animation.

capabilities.label: Self-contained React component export
capabilities.useWhen: A tuned sticker must be emitted as a reusable React component backed by Three.js.

capabilities.label: Interactive studio controls and settings persistence
capabilities.useWhen: The product itself needs upload, foil tuning, layer controls, dark mode, or JSON settings import and export.
